clauses.clause: Sole clause: amends sec. 403 of EO 10161 by redesignating paragraph (b) as (c) and inserting a new paragraph (b) providing up to two labor and two business alternate members of the Wage Stabilization Board, appointed by the President with Senate consent, participating only in lieu of an absent member when called by the Chairman.

data_errors: The evidence slice lists EO 10390 as acting on EO 10377 by amendment. The text of EO 10390 names only EO 10161 'as amended'; EO 10377 is not named in it. The link is at most indirect and was not checked against the text of EO 10377.
The OFR 1989 table disposition reads 'Revokedby EO 10480' (missing space). EO 10480 sec. 607 says 'superseded or revoked' without saying which applies to each order.

moves.note: Held Federal Register printing (17 FR 7995) is legible; the order has one operative clause, an amendment inserting sec. 403(b) into EO 10161.
EO 10480 sec. 607(11) names EO 10390 as superseded or revoked; read in the held FR printing of EO 10480.
The single clause ended 1953-08-14; the parent EO 10161 is ended by the same section, item (1).
No open gap; every proposition is quoted from held official printings. The sec. 606 savings clause covers subordinate actions and things done, not the order itself.

propositions.claim: EO 10390 is printed in the Federal Register of September 4, 1952, at 17 FR 7995, signed August 30, 1952.
propositions.quote: EXECUTIVE ORDER 10390 ... Harry S. T ruman The W hite H ouse, August 30, 1952. [P. R. Doc. 52-9695; Filed, Sept. 2, 1952

propositions.claim: The order's only command is an amendment to section 403 of EO 10161.
propositions.quote: it is ordered that section 403 of Executive Order No. 10161 of September 9, 1950 (15 P. R. 6105), as amended, be, and it is hereby, further amended

propositions.claim: The inserted paragraph (b) provides alternate members of the Wage Stabilization Board.
propositions.quote: the Board shall have not more than two alternate members who shall be repre­sentative of labor and not more than two alternate members who shall be representative of business and industry

propositions.claim: EO 10480 sec. 607 expressly names EO 10390 among the orders superseded or revoked.
propositions.quote: S ec. 607. The following are superseded or revoked: ... (11) Executive Order No. 10390 of August 30, 1952 (17 F. R. 7995).

propositions.claim: The same section ends the parent order, EO 10161, which EO 10390 amended.
propositions.quote: (1) Executive Order No. 10161 of Septem­ber 9, 1950 (15 F. R. 6105).

propositions.claim: EO 10480 was signed August 14, 1953, and printed in the Federal Register of August 20, 1953.
propositions.quote: Dwight D. E isenhower T he W hite H ouse, August 14, 1953. [F. R. Doc. 53-7384; Filed, Aug. 18, 1953

propositions.claim: The Federal Register codification guide in the same issue lists EO 10390 as superseded by EO 10480.
EO 10480 sec. 606 saves subordinate orders, regulations and actions and things already done; it does not continue the superseded executive orders named in sec. 607.
propositions.quote: All orders, regulations, rul­ings, certificates, directives and other actions relating to any function affected by this order shall remain in effect ex­cept as they are inconsistent herewith

propositions.claim: EO 10390 is not among the orders that EO 10480 sec. 608 keeps in effect; the orders listed there are EO 10182 (as amended by EO 10205), EO 10219 and EO 10224.
propositions.quote: The following designated orders, modified as required to conform them to the provi­sions of this order, shall remain in effect: Executive Order No. 10182

review.conclusion_reason: EO 10480 expressly ends both EO 10390 and its parent on August 14, 1953. This satisfies the named-ending rule and resolves the amendment's operative status. Sections 606 and 608 do not continue its commands.

verdicts.reason: Held original identifies EO 10390, September 4, 1952 issue, page 7995, and August 30 signature date.
Full order consists of the stated amendment to section 403 of EO 10161.
Inserted paragraph expressly provides up to two labor and two business and industry alternates.
Section 607 says 'The following are superseded or revoked' and item (11) expressly names EO 10390.
Section 607(1) expressly lists parent EO 10161 under the same ending language.
Signature block confirms August 14, 1953; issue heading confirms August 20 publication.
Held codification guide expressly lists '10390 (superseded by E. O. 10480)'.
Full section 606 preserves consistent existing actions and things previously done. Its inconsistency exception, read with section 607's express ending, does not preserve EO 10390 itself.
Complete section 608 continuation list contains precisely the stated orders and excludes EO 10390.
